name: Fine Feathered Friend

angles.text: As a druid, aiding the renewal of the natural world and seeking out ancient spirits of nature lies at the heart of your calling.

faq.answer: You seek a powerful entity who appears as a small bird, resting among corrupted grounds upon the southwestern slope.
faq.q: Who are you sent to find?

faq.answer: Journey west toward the ashen, corrupted lands that spread across the southwestern slope.
With nature beginning to stir anew, her great strength is needed to confront a far more dire threat.
faq.q: Why is this strange bird needed?

sections.body: Nature stirs with fresh life as the ancients begin to rise once more. Your aid has tipped the balance toward renewal, yet a far darker blight looms in the west. Across the ashen ground of the southwestern slope rests a small bird, a creature whose modest shape hides immense strength. Turning to her aid may offer the strength needed to heal a wounded world.
sections.title: A Beacon in the Ash

summary: The cycle of renewal begins to stir, and the ancients prepare to rise again. To aid a troubled land, you are sent west to the ashen slopes to find an unlikely ally disguised as a small bird.
attribution: In-game quest text: Fine Feathered Friend
